title: Fridgeroo on Tour – Part 5: The shared house
feature: shared home (one fridge list for the whole house, every item shows its owner)

scenes.label: 🚨 SHELF WAR
scenes.sfx: tug creak 0.0/0.5/1.0, tape rip 0.3, tags flutter 1.4; both housemates pull a yogurt across a masking-tape line on the open fridge's middle shelf
scenes.note: frame 1: tug-of-war mid-pull, red tags on left half, blue tags on right half; two housemates (second cast) both visible

scenes.say: Shelf two is a|war zone.|YOU ate the|yogurt. I know.
scenes.note: hero steps between them, yogurt pops free and he catches it; stare on 'YOU'
hologram list with red/blue owner dots; tags snap onto items and food floats back to the matching coloured side; housemates fist-bump

caption: Part 5 of Fridgeroo on Tour: two housemates, one yogurt and a tape line, until Fridgeroo's shared list showed who owns what 🥛 Use it or lose it. fridgeroo.netlify.app – Who in your house is the yogurt thief?

newProps.secondResident: second housemate from cast.second, stands at pos.stu2, mirrored pose; both face the fridge in scene 1.
newProps.shelfwar: masking-tape line down the middle shelf, red tags left / blue tags right. Action shelfwar {sortAt}: tug-of-war on one yogurt (both pull, rubber-band stretch), at sortAt tags snap onto items and mismatched foods float (arc, no clipping through shelves) back to their colour side; end with a fist-bump.

voiceText: [amused, sarcastic] Tape on a fridge? Adorable. [long pause] [heroic] Shelf two is a war zone. [long pause] [slow, serious, to camera] YOU ate the yogurt. I know. [long pause] [grudging, then warm] Shared list. Everyone sees what's theirs.
ytTitle: Housemates fight over ONE yogurt | Fridgeroo on Tour 5
